units.content: Models recursive self-modification of world models, policies, representations, evaluators and architecture under identity/viability constraints.
T:(G_t,O_t)->(G_t+1,O_t+1) represents source self-modification dynamics.
Source distinguishes self-correction, which improves beliefs/heuristics while preserving identity, from self-corruption, which rewrites core values/viability/evaluator criteria.
Viability/agency kernels, timescale separation, partial fixed points, attractor dynamics, transition stability and V_core preservation constrain recursive updates.
Frozen systems, oscillation, recursive collapse, goal drift and capability without continuity are proposed failure modes.
Theoretical self-modification model; no recursive self-modification experiment or observed trajectory is reported here.
Unifies causal language, normative model and transformation operator into a lexicographically constrained CGET objective.
This file expands CGET as 'Causal Generative Execution Theory', differing from README/overview 'Causal Generative Equilibrium Theory'; no silent canonicalization is authorized.
Operational leverage is future-structure complexity divided by model complexity, execution cost and stability term; used as capability objective inside a feasible region.
Identity, causal truth, closure and transition stability are proposed as non-compensable feasibility conditions before leverage optimization.

Source interprets intelligence as conserved transformation: remove unnecessary degrees of freedom while preserving invariant ones; compression without preservation is corruption, preservation without compression is stagnation.
Framework-internal objective/principle; not an observed optimization law or empirically established universal objective.
Defines observations and experiments that could distinguish or falsify CGET relative to scaling, prediction, reward optimization, memorization or uncontrolled complexity.

content: causal compression should precede capability expansion
executability should matter for practical intelligence
agency should track controllable rather than merely reachable futures
recursive intelligence should remain in viable regions
representation quality should explain intelligence beyond parameter count

units.content: Programming-language progression, hurricanes and other examples are used as motivating interpretations of predictions, not execution evidence for them.
Proposes representation-intervention, agency-measurement and self-modification-stability experiment classes with equal-resource and structural measurements.

Each prediction includes source-specified falsifiers; final criterion says CGET is wrong if intelligence can increase indefinitely without improved causal compression, controllable reach or invariant preservation.
Prediction/falsification registry; predictions are not source-reported observations or experimental results.
Positions CGET as a proposed synthesis layer relating components of existing work rather than replacing those fields.
This file expands CGET as 'Causal Generative Executable Theory', another source-local name variant preserved without reconciliation.

Source describes conceptual relationships/differences with algorithmic information theory, causal inference, reinforcement learning, control/viability theory, predictive processing/active inference, self-modification/alignment, thermodynamics/information theory and AGI research.
Named external fields/frameworks are source-side conceptual references only; exact literature objects/endpoints are not resolved here and no Program Map edges are emitted.
Source proposes compression + causal execution + agency + invariant preservation as a shared recursive problem/synthesis, while explicitly denying that individual disciplines are thereby invalid.
Proposed synthesis/relationship analysis, not evidence that the claimed cross-field common structure has been independently established.
Applies CGET to concrete systems; source explicitly says the examples are not intended to prove the framework through retrospective explanation.

Newtonian mechanics, automatic differentiation, alpha-beta pruning, AlphaZero, thermostats, evolution and LLMs are interpreted through compression, causality, agency and self-modification coordinates.
Hypothetical CGET-aligned AGI requirements are illustrative target conditions, not an implemented or observed AGI system.

Source comparison table assigns qualitative CGET profiles to rocks, thermostats, classical AI, AlphaZero, evolution, LLMs and a CGET Agent; these labels are source interpretations, not measured benchmark outputs.
Case-study/example layer; statements such as 'AlphaZero demonstrates' retain source interpretation standing and do not become validated historical results through compression.
Enumerates unresolved theoretical, mathematical and empirical problems required to turn CGET from theoretical framework into validated theory.

Open formal problems include rigorous intelligence definition, necessary constraints, causal-compression measurement, causal/value closure, core-identity discovery, transition-stability metrics, agency measurement and computational tractability.
Empirical validation remains open; source proposes representation, alignment and agency tests but reports no completed validation in this file.
Relationship to biological intelligence, AGI sufficiency, consciousness and self-modeling remain explicitly unresolved.
Existence of stable attractors/viability kernels, bounds on self-modification, compression-complexity relations and value-closure characterization remain mathematical open problems.
Ultimate unresolved question: can a system recursively increase reality-transformation ability while preserving the invariants that make that transformation meaningful?
Makes foundational CGET assumptions explicit as candidate points of empirical validation or falsification rather than claiming an assumption-free foundation.
Assumptions include compressible reality, intervention-relevant causal structure, executable representations, compression under constraints and compositional generalization.
Assumptions include viability constraints, structural identity invariants, timescale separation, future control as agency and alignment as internal to intelligence.
Assumptions include self-modification creating a recursive optimization problem, structured future space, transformable computational resources and intelligence as a dynamical property.
Framework assumes its proposed structure is empirically falsifiable and lists conditions under which major components should be rejected or modified.
These are source-labelled assumptions, not established facts or observations.
Defines minimum conceptual commitments of the CGET framework as axioms.

Twelve source-labelled axioms cover compression, causal preservation, executability, closure, agency, viability, identity preservation, timescale separation, transition stability, conserved transformation, recursive intelligence and alignment internality.
Master axiom compresses CGET to invariant-preserving compression under self-modifying dynamics with expanding controllable future reach.
Implication text provides framework consequences/examples of the axioms; implication is not independent evidence for an axiom.

Source explicitly says axioms define conceptual structure and do not yet constitute a complete mathematical theory; formal proofs, measurable definitions, experiments and falsification remain required.
Mathematical reference for proposed CGET vocabulary across representation, causal modeling, execution, agency, normative stability and self-modification.
Defines s_t=(G_t,O_t), T update, G=(Z,B,Omega,rho), X->Z, epistemic leverage, causal fidelity and causal closure.
Defines V_O, soft viability, C_O, value invariance, timescale separation and viability kernel.
Defines agency kernel and A_control via steerable/reachable futures.
Defines transition stability, core-loss and transformation intelligence ratio Theta*.
Defines Psi_stable multiplicative objective, lexicographic ordering and a master equation relating compressed causal reach, control and invariant loss.
Research note explicitly says equations define proposed mathematical vocabulary and are not assumed proven; computable approximations, empirical measurements and falsification remain future work.
Conceptual definition glossary for CGET.
Defines agency/reachability/steerability, causal compression/closure/fidelity/language, conserved compression, epistemic engine and executable representation.
Defines identity, drift/invariants, normative engine/collapse, observer model, value closure/core/adaptive/invariance and viability.
Defines fixed points/attractor manifolds/partial fixed points, policy space, self-modification, steering bandwidth and transition/timescale concepts.

Glossary master definition repeats CGET intelligence as invariant-preserving compression with self-modification and expanding controllable reach; definition standing does not make it an empirically established property.
Local CGET symbol dictionary.
Maps X,Z,G,O,B,Omega,rho,Pi, V terms, closure/fidelity/stability kernels, A_control, Theta*, Psi_stable, complexity/cost and tolerances to source-local meanings.
Within R10 notation, Omega denotes composition algebra. This local meaning creates no identity with Omega usages in other repositories.
